topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text:
The rain's been a constant companion these last few days, drumming against the roof like an old pal with nowhere else to go. I get a call from a woman, new in town, painted fingernails tapping impatiently on the phone. She's got an attic full of secrets left by the folks who fled before her. Said she's found trunks up there, filled with letters, old clothes, and God knows what else. Her voice was a mix of curiosity and caution, like a cat eyeing a half-opened can of tuna.

I told her I'd take a look, that maybe the past was trying to tell her something. Maybe, just maybe, there's a story in those trunks worth uncovering. But I've learned not to trust the first story. People hide things, and sometimes it's their own history they're burying. I’ll bring my raincoat and my skepticism.
